bull_bear.body:
- In-house breeding / R&D programme with stated objectives of drought, pest and disease tolerance, high yields with seasonal and geographical adaptability, enhanced nutritional value and alignment with end-user preferences
- Dealer and distributor network across states, described as a continuing area of emphasis
- Seed processing capabilities, cited by the Managing Director alongside R&D and distribution as enabling market presence
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Climatic and seasonal uncertainty in a seasonal seed business — MD&A lists climatic and seasonal uncertainties among key risks. The auditors' Key Audit Matter reinforces the structural nature of this: the Company operates a seasonal seed business, resulting in significant inventory levels at year-end, with inventory piling up in view of seasonal business patterns.
- Inventory existence, ageing and net-realisable-value risk, with substantial customer returns — Flagged by the statutory auditors as a Key Audit Matter. The nature of the business involves substantial customer returns in certain product categories and periods, and valuation involves judgment on condition, ageing, slow-moving stock, returned goods and quality deterioration. Physical verification could not be carried out at 31 March 2026 and was performed on a subsequent date on a sample basis.
- Working capital and receivable risk, with unconfirmed balances — MD&A lists working capital and receivable risks. The auditors' Emphasis of Matter records that trade receivables, payables, loans and advances (including advances given to growers and deposits given) are subject to confirmation and reconciliation.
- Qualified audit opinion on MSME interest non-provision, with unquantified impact — The Statutory Auditors qualified their opinion on non-provision of interest payable to MSME creditors under Section 16 of the MSMED Act, 2006, and on Schedule III / Section 22 disclosure requirements, stating the impact on the financial statements cannot be reported due to lack of information. The Board records that the review and reconciliation is in progress and the precise financial impact could not be reliably ascertained.
- Fluctuations in agricultural demand and changing customer preferences — MD&A key risks. A single-segment, single-crop-input business has no diversification buffer if farmer demand or varietal preference shifts.
- Regulatory and policy change in the agriculture sector — MD&A cites changes in government regulations and policies among key risks; the cautionary statement also names government policies as a factor that may cause actual results to differ materially.
- Competitive market conditions and supply chain disruption — MD&A key risks. The Company describes its environment as competitive yet growth-oriented and lists supply chain disruptions separately.
- Inflationary pressure and input cost fluctuation — MD&A key risks. Input cost movement is a direct margin exposure for a seed producer sourcing from growers.
- Single-segment and geographic concentration — Structural concentration: the Company states it operates in a single reportable segment and that segment-wise reporting is not applicable; foreign exchange earnings and outgoings are NIL, so revenue is entirely domestic, with operations based at Ranebennur, Karnataka.
- Newly listed SME with a governance framework still being built out — The Company listed on the BSE SME platform in December 2025; the corporate governance report is not applicable to it under Regulation 15(2) of SEBI LODR, and management states it is focused on strengthening corporate governance, internal controls and regulatory compliance as a newly listed company.

business.body: Unisem Agritech Limited is engaged in the business of agricultural and allied products, with a stated focus on hybrid field crop seeds and delivering quality solutions to farmers and agri-business stakeholders. The Company operates in a single reportable segment and sells through a dealer and distributor network spread across states. Its emphasis is on research and product development, seed processing capability and expanding geographical reach.
business.title: What they do

business.body: - **Agricultural and allied products (single segment):** Hybrid field crop seeds, Vegetable and field crop seeds
business.title: Products & brands

business.body: - Seednet Agri Private Limited — related party: Added as an additional related party by Board resolution of 25 May 2026 subject to shareholder approval. The son of Mr. Dharanendra H Gouda (Director & Promoter) is a Director & Promoter of it, and the daughter of Mr. B H Devasingh Naik (CEO & Promoter) is a Director and Promoter of it. Transactions contemplated are sale/purchase/supply of goods or materials, leasing of property, availing/rendering of services and appointment of agents, in the ordinary course of business on an arm's length basis.

outlook.body:
- Broaden the hybrid seed product portfolio and strengthen the product offering
- Deepen market penetration and expand geographical reach into rural and semi-urban agricultural markets
- Strengthen the dealer and distributor network and customer relationships
- Continue investment in research and development of hybrid seed varieties adapted to diverse agro-climatic conditions
- Improve operational efficiency, production efficiencies and supply-chain capability
- Strengthen corporate governance, internal controls and regulatory compliance as a newly listed company
- Explore strategic growth opportunities in the agriculture sector
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: The FY2025-26 annual report describes no named capex project, plant addition or capacity-expansion timeline. Expansion is framed only qualitatively: following the December 2025 listing on the BSE SME platform the Company states it continued its efforts towards business expansion, operational streamlining and improving organizational systems, and intends to keep expanding market reach, geographical presence and the dealer/distributor network across states, strengthening supply-chain capabilities and investing in R&D and seed processing capability. The IPO of 33,00,000 equity shares at Rs. 65 each aggregating Rs. 2,145.00 Lakhs was raised for working capital, repayment of banking facilities and general corporate purposes — not for a capital project. The Directors' Report records R&D expenditure incurred as NIL and states no technology was imported. No commissioning, ramp-up or debottlenecking language appears anywhere in the routed bundles.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Rising adoption of hybrid seeds and increasing farmer awareness of quality agricultural inputs, cited by the Managing Director as providing a strong platform for future expansion
- Growing adoption of scientific farming techniques and modernisation of farming practices
- Expansion in rural and semi-urban agricultural markets and improved market penetration
- Government initiatives, reforms, policy support and rural infrastructure/digitisation programmes supporting agriculture and allied sectors
- Rising demand for high-yield and climate-resilient varieties, and growth in vegetable and field crop seeds
- Increasing focus on sustainable agriculture and government emphasis on food security
- Management states it remains optimistic about the long-term growth prospects of the Company and the Indian agriculture sector
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers

deepdive.thesis: Unisem Agritech Limited is a Karnataka-based hybrid seed and agri-inputs company serving farmers and agri-business stakeholders across India, listed on the BSE SME platform in December 2025.

open.item: The Board has directed management to expeditiously complete the review and reconciliation of MSME creditor dues and to make appropriate accounting treatment and disclosures in the ensuing financial statements.

IPO proceeds of Rs. 2,145.00 Lakhs from the issue of 33,00,000 equity shares at Rs. 65 each are to be applied to working capital requirements, repayment of banking facilities and general corporate purposes.

As a newly listed company the management is focused on strengthening corporate governance, internal controls and regulatory compliance while pursuing strategic growth opportunities in the agriculture sector.
The Company will continue to focus on broadening its product portfolio, deepening market penetration, strengthening operational capabilities and delivering consistent and sustainable growth.
The Company will continue investing in R&D to develop advanced hybrid seed varieties better adapted to diverse agro-climatic conditions and evolving farming practices.

The Company intends to continue focusing on expanding market reach, strengthening customer relationships, improving operational efficiencies, enhancing supply chain capabilities and maintaining product quality standards.
